_about: The Deck: apps of the SYRIX ecosystem that the HUD can launch. Read by syrix-deck.js in the main process; the renderer only ever sends an id from this list. ${NAME} expands to an environment variable, or to SYRIX_ELECTRON (the Electron runtime the HUD itself runs on). 'run' starts a program detached; 'url' opens an https address in the default browser; 'reuse' opens an address instead of launching when that address already answers; 'probe' only drives the running indicator.
